components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single tap-inviting action — spring lime, 52px tall, 12px corners.

components.name: Neutral Button
components.description: Quiet lime-wash control for capture-modals and modal-close — the faintest step of the lime tint family.
components.css: .ds-btn-neutral { background: rgba(101,163,13,0.05); color: #18181b; font-family: 'Host Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 24px; min-height: 52px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-neutral:hover { background: rgba(101,163,13,0.1); } .ds-btn-neutral:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #64a30d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-neutral:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Cloud surface, fog border, ink focus — soft and friendly.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Host Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #18181b; } .ds-input { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px; min-height: 52px; font-family: 'Host Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #18181b; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #d6d6da; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #18181b; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Radio Selection Tile
components.description: Pick-one tile: bouncy rounded, leaf-tint fill and fern border when selected.
components.css: .ds-radio { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #f3f4f6; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; font-family: 'Host Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #18181b; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-radio .ds-radio-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; background: #f4f4f5; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 24px; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-radio:hover { border-color: #d6d6da; } .ds-radio.selected { background: rgba(101, 163, 13, 0.1); border-color: #64a30d; } .ds-radio.selected .ds-radio-icon { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); } .ds-radio:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #64a30d; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
NaCal is a food diary that refuses to feel like medicine. It trades the clinical precision of calorie counters for the ease of a friendly meal table: airy, garden-fresh surfaces in cloud white and soft mist, energized by a single bright lime accent, with every corner gently rounded. Screens breathe — spacing is generous, nothing crowds, and one glance is enough to understand the day. The aesthetic philosophy is fresh-squeezed optimism: optimistic without shouting, friendly without silliness, reassuring in flawless Brazilian Portuguese.

The system is a study in rationed color. Most of the interface is quiet: white panels on misty grays separated by hairline borders, tonal wells instead of shadows. Color arrives deliberately — spring lime for the single moment of action, four macro hues only where nutrition data is shown, and deep fern ink for the moments of ceremony (offer-your-plan, capture-your-meal) where the app asks the user to pause and trust it. Depth comes from stillness and tonal layering, not elevation.
keyCharacteristics: Airy and optimistic: cloud-white panels over a lime-bright wash, generous spacing, nothing crowded.
Soft geometry: every corner rounded (10–24px), pill hero CTAs, circular icon wells and recording rings.
Tonal, not shadowy: depth from mist/fog wells and 1px borders; shadows only on floating actions.
Reassuring, friendly br-PT voice throughout ("Você pode inserir uma estimativa", "Só usada no momento da foto").
The MacroRainbow as signature: four colored arcs make daily progress legible at a glance.

rules.name: The Fresh-Plate Rule
rules.body: Spring lime is rationed. Page washes and selections use lime bright or leaf tint; full spring lime is reserved for the one element asking for a tap. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The White-Panel Rule
rules.body: Content lives on cloud. Mist and fog layers define containment; they never compete with content for attention.

rules.name: The Macro-Rainbow Rule
rules.body: The four macro hues exist to encode calories, protein, carbs, and fats — and nothing else. They must never decorate unrelated UI.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Within a paragraph, weight changes carry hierarchy; color highlights are allowed only for macro data and interactive links. Never colorize prose for emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Cards contain themselves with a hairline border and a tonal well — a shadow only appears for a floating action or a lifted sheet.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: When a surface recedes under a scrim (welcome CTA), use a dark translucent layer (rgba(0,0,0,0.4)) plus backdrop blur — flat coverage, soft separation.

rules.name: The Nothing-Square Rule
rules.body: Every interactive shape ends rounded. If you can't decide, 12px corners on a 48–52px control.

rules.name: The Circle Signature Rule
rules.body: Circles mean "me" and "capture": avatars, recording rings, and release points stay perfectly round.

dos: Do give every screen air: 20–24px gutters and a 4/8/16/24/32px rhythm.
Do reserve spring lime for the tap-inviting element, use lime bright/leaf tint for washes and selections.
Do keep content on cloud and contain it with mist wells and hairline fog borders.
Do keep touch targets at 48–52px minimum and round every corner (10px minimum).
Do use the four macro hues only to encode calories / protein / carbs / fats.
Do write copy that reassures and never judges ("Você pode inserir uma estimativa").
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color; spring lime is the only voice.
Don't square off corners or use shadows on resting cards.
Don't decorate decorative UI with the macro palette.
Don't use clinical or rigid language — this is "controle sua dieta de forma simples", not a hospital chart.
Don't push content edge-to-edge; sheets and panels always keep their gutters.
